entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something? I bought a helmet a while ago, and I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you tell me a little more about the situation? What specifically is the issue with the helmet?

Oh, well, there's nothing wrong with it. It's just... the color. It looked different online. It's still in the box, the box is completely unopened. I just... I don't know the rules. Can't you just help me?
Of course. It sounds like a preference issue, not a technical one, which is perfectly fine. I just need to check a few details. Do you know roughly when you purchased it?
Um, it was a while back... maybe... 80 days ago? I think? I'm sorry, I'm not very organized.
Not a problem at all, I can look that up for you with your account information. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 80 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. According to our policy, you have 90 days to return an item. Since you're at day 80, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. Especially with a safety item like a helmet, we want to make sure you're completely happy with your choice. And since the box is unopened, it makes the process very simple. I've just initiated the return for you and you'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the hour.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah! You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
